tool_input.description: Before/after screenshots and pixel diff stats

result:
I found the cause of the slow scrolling on the Store home page `/`, and I have a fix ready for stage 2. No store file was changed, and the protected files are untouched (check rc 0).

**The cause:** three large decorative brass glows drawn with `filter: blur()`. Two sit in `ProductSection.tsx` (lines 38–39) and slow the first stretch of scrolling (scrollY about 360–900). The third, an 800px glow in `StudioShowcase.tsx` (line 75), slows the second stretch (about 1850–2020).

**What I measured:**
- **Reproduced:** on the HEAD production build, `/` had a median of 6 slow frames at 1440 and 5 at 1280. B measured 9 / 8; both are well above the bound of 2. `/free-downloads` had 0 slow frames, as B found.
- **Trace:** almost all the time goes to drawing (raster) the page on worker threads, about 918 ms across the 9 slow frames. The main thread mostly waits for it. Script, including Lenis, is about 117 ms in total.
- **Screens, one suspect hidden at a time (7 in total):**
  - Hiding all the glows gives 0 / 0.
  - The ProductSection glows alone remove the first slow stretch; the Showcase glow alone removes the second.
  - The hero image's slow zoom effect is not the cause.
  - Moving the glows onto their own layer (`will-change`) makes it much worse, 71 / 57. Stage 2 should not try that.
- **Fix build:** I replaced the three blurs with Tailwind radial gradients (`bg-radial`) in the same theme colours, scaled to the same reach. The diff is in `proposal.diff.txt`, and `patch --dry-run` applies it to a fresh `9ba13ac` copy.
  - Two separate runs gave 0 / 0 on `/`.
  - Scrolling stays eased: moving frames 167–190, `finalY` 2400.
  - `/free-downloads` stays at 0.
- **Smaller fix tried:** changing only the two ProductSection glows gave 2 / 0, just at the limit, with one pass at 3. The second slow stretch stays, so the proposal changes all three.

**What it looks like:** the glows keep their shape and position and are about 1/255 brighter on average (largest pixel difference 6.7 of 255). Screenshots and diff numbers are in `proposal-visual/`, at 1440 and 1280. Page width and height are unchanged at 1440, 1280 and 375. B and product-designer still need to rule on this look change.

The three rulings hold: Lenis is unchanged, no keep-list component is touched, and neither `root.tsx` nor `app/styles/**` is touched.

**Tests:** I ran these on a scratch copy with the fix, not on the store tree:
- Biome on the two files: clean except one warning that already exists at HEAD.
- The two test files that cover these components: 13 of 13 pass.
- I did not run typecheck because only class names changed. No code-reviewer was needed, since no store file changed.

**Limits:**
- This machine has no real GPU (SwiftShader software drawing), which makes blurs far more expensive than on a normal computer. The cause is confirmed here; Saba's own device remains its own check (TLM-R468-SABA-SCROLL-DEVICE).
- The probe stops at scrollY 2400, so similar blur glows lower on the home page and on other pages are listed for B but not measured. One of them is in SpecialOffers, which is on the keep-list.

**Housekeeping:**
- I stopped every server I started; the shared one on :5173 was not touched.
- I deleted the three rebuildable copies of the store (about 325 MB each) and compressed the two traces. `a-round-468/` is now 15 MB.
- To start the mock API from the loop folder, use `realpath`, because the symlinked path stops it from starting.

Everything is in `tmp/studio-real-loop/`. The report also has the next checks for C. I did not mark any of C's rows or the backlog as done.

Files are in `tmp/studio-real-loop/`:
- a-round-468.md
- a-round-468/proposal.diff.txt
- a-round-468/bisect.md
- a-round-468/trace-summary.md
